_comment: Where tools/title_progress.py finds Call of Duty: Black Ops and what cannot be read from its sources. Paths are this machine's checkouts; nothing of the title is in this repository.
name: Call of Duty: Black Ops

sys.where: all eight groups, opt-in: `--any360_sys_groups=stateless,files,objects,threads,memory,xam,input,audio`; no call reaches ReXGlue's kernel in its first minute and a half, its local server's sockets on Any360's network (loopback: nothing leaves the machine)

gfx.where: opt-in: `--any360_gpu=true`; the game draws its first scenes through `any360::gfx` at 60 FPS (1,700 to 1,800 draws a frame with every system call on `any360::sys`)
